sourceConclusions.evidence: Publication checks the captured pairing attempt and termination state. The identity assignment and post-cleanup application also guard current ownership. Missing or non-32-byte keys fail before restoration; selection errors and listener-start failure do not publish ready. Only a ready outcome schedules pending automatic recovery.

Ready means saved pairing/listener restored, not authenticated connectivity. Final user-facing copy uses saved connection and phone rather than identity, key or journal. Permission wording is conditional. Missing-data copy does not promise that restarting repairs it. The ready copy says Your phone is paired.

Pending recovery suppresses premature first-run and connection labels. Terminal errors remove the progress indicator and retain the incomplete recovery gate. Normal completed connected headers still depend on existing connection state. Native rendering and accessibility are unverified.

contract: Add a versioned authenticated non-destructive status exchange using existing transport security. Report admitted, awaitingReconnect or busy; bind response to a fresh request, current pairing/identities, verified network binding and opaque admission-state token.

Status alone cannot authorize teardown. Android atomically checks an eligible unadmitted token and reserves one bounded attempt, returning authenticated acceptance. Mac keeps its admission until acceptance and captured local lifetime/generation/cancellation/network/deadline checks pass.

Recheck ownership and state at subsequent destructive transitions. An intervening successful reconnect invalidates stale status, acceptance and Proof. Never pass a stale conditional attempt into unconditional retirement of newer admission.

Authenticate explicit version, mode, direction and phase separation throughout the transcript. Do not overload legacy Challenge, ACK or nonce fields. Preserve full bidirectional proof and durable replay protection.

Unsupported status, timeout, auth failure, malformed data, healthy or busy responses preserve existing admission. Automatic recovery never falls back to destructive legacy reconnect; retain existing manual compatibility.

All status, handoff, cleanup and handshake work fits the existing 30-second ceiling. No permanent retry, heartbeat, user-action replay or sensitive logging. Cleanup owns only this attempt's resources.
nextProtocolDecision.authorizedNextWork: Contract and shared Swift/Kotlin vectors plus deterministic ownership tests first; then narrowly implement status and conditional handoff behind an explicit internal entry point. Review production paths before any discovery-event wiring.
requiredTests: Healthy admission and active transfer survive status and forged/duplicate discovery hints unchanged.
An unadmitted restarted peer permits exactly one authenticated replacement.
Admission installed between status and handoff rejects the older token without teardown.
Reject expired, duplicate, replayed, wrong-peer, wrong-mode and wrong-phase messages.
Fence cancellation, lock/network changes, pairing replacement and stale callbacks at suspension points.
Verify old/new peer compatibility, shared deadline exhaustion and cleanup that cannot close newer resources.
